title: Parameter-Free and Group Conditional Online Conformal Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2606.00419v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Quantifying the uncertainty in predictions made by machine learning models is challenging in online settings where the characteristics of the data and labels change over time. Online conformal prediction (OCP) methods tackle this problem by producing intervals for each observation and guaranteeing that a proportion of them contain their labels, a property known as marginal coverage. OCP methods, however, may systematically miscover observations belonging to groups defined by attributes like age or race, raising fairness concerns. Group-conditional OCP (G-OCP) methods address this by producing intervals that provide coverage for multiple groups. Existing approaches rely on learning rates, which control how they react to changes in the data stream, but can be hard to tune in online settings. Leveraging advancements in learning-rate-free methods, we develop a learning-rate-free G-OCP algorithm with strong group-coverage guarantees

translated_title: 免参数与群组条件在线保形预测
translated_abstract: 在数据特征和标签随时间变化的在线环境中，量化机器学习模型预测的不确定性是一项挑战。在线保形预测（OCP）方法通过为每个观测值生成预测区间来应对这一问题，并保证其中一定比例的区间包含真实标签，这一性质被称为边际覆盖率。然而，OCP方法可能会系统性地对属于某些群组（如由年龄或种族等属性定义的群组）的观测值产生错误覆盖，从而引发公平性方面的担忧。群组条件OCP（G-OCP）方法通过生成能够为多个群组提供覆盖保证的预测区间来解决这一问题。现有方法依赖于学习率来控制其对数据流变化的反应方式，但学习率在在线环境中难以调优。借助免学习率方法的最新进展，我们开发了一种免学习率的G-OCP算法，该算法具有强大的群组覆盖保证。
tldr: 本文提出了一种免参数（无需学习率调优）的群组条件在线保形预测算法，能够在数据分布随时间变化的在线环境中为多个群组提供强大的覆盖保证，从而解决公平性问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a learning-rate-free group-conditional online conformal prediction algorithm that provides strong group-coverage guarantees in online settings with shifting data distributions, addressing fairness concerns without parameter tuning.
